name: SikaTile-010 Secure Prime
paste:
SIKATILE®-010 SECURE PRIME: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaTile®-010 Secure Prime, November 2024, Version 01.06 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/h/sikatile-010-secureprime.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaTile®-010 Secure Prime where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2024, Version 01.06).
1.2 Product description.
    - SikaTile®-010 Secure Prime is a high performance, ready to use, primer with efflorescence inhibiting properties suitable for porous and dense substrates.
    - SikaTile®-010 Secure Prime helps prevent efflorescence by reducing the porosity of concrete, screeds and renders with its unique crystalline technology.
    - SikaTile®-010 Secure Prime is suitable for use internally and externally on both wall and floor applications.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaTile®-010 Secure Prime is suitable for the following applications.
    - General purpose under tile priming of porous substrates
    - General purpose primer for water-based waterproofing membranes
    - Primer to prevent efflorescence coming out of substrates, ie concrete, screeds and renders
    - Priming of dense and steel trowelled concrete
    - Concrete
    - Cement boards and sheets including ScyonTM
    - Plasterboard
    - Glass re-inforced concrete
    - Cement based screeds and renders
    - Cement coated light weight construction boards
    - Autoclaved Aerated Concrete (AAC)
    Suitable substrates include.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.6.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaTile®-010 Secure Prime
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: A HIGH PERFORMANCE MULTI-PURPOSE PRIMER WITH EFFLORESCENCE INHIBITING PROPERTIES FOR POROUS AND DENSE SUBSTRATES
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports.
    - Green Star - VOC Content Test Certificate
    Green Star Design & As Built V1.3-13.1.1B
    Green Star Interiors V1.3-12.1.1B
    6 Grams per Litre as VOC content per material
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Ready to use, no mixing required
    - Multiple uses, porous and dense concrete
    - Inhibiting Efflorescence coming out of substrates
    - Reduces substrate porosity through crystalline technology
    - Reduced moisture migration by capillary action
    - Versatile - suitable for internal, and external use including submerged applications such as tiled pools and spas.
    - Low VOC
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Milky white liquid, dries clear.
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: 6 grams per Litre
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 5 Litre pails
    - Shelf life: 9 months from date of manufacture if stored out of direct sunlight unopened in original container.
    - Storage conditions: Store in dry cool conditions our of direct sunlight. Do not allow product to freeze.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2024, Version 01.06) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment.
    - All substrates shall be free from loose friable materials, dust, and debris, release agents, curing compounds, grease, sealers and other contaminating materials. Contaminated substrates must be mechanically prepared to expose at least 80% of the original substrate.
    - Early aged concrete shall be a minimum of 7 days old at 22°C & 50% relative humidity prior to application.
    - Early aged cement-based screeds shall be a minimum of 24 hours old at 22°C and 50% relative humidity per 40mm of thickness.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2024, Version 01.06) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Yield: Approximately 13 m² per litre dependant on substrate porosity.
    - Curing time: 25-40 minutes dependant on climate, substrate porosity, and application technique.
4.3 Equipment.
    - Brush, roller or low pressure spray applicator
    - Protective personal equipment
4.4 Application.
    - Apply the SikaTile®-010 Secure Prime to substrates as required with a brush, roller or low pressure spray applicator.
    - Allow the primer to dry prior to subsequent application of waterproofing membrane or tile adhesive.
    - Application of the waterproofing membrane or tile adhesive should be undertaken after the primer has dried to minimise the chance of contamination.
4.5 Cleaning of equipment. Tools and equipment can be cleaned with water while the product is still wet.
4.6 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Not for use as a vapour barrier or in areas of rising damp.
    - Do not dilute
    - Use in temperatures between 5°C and 35°C
    - SikaTile®-010 Secure Prime is not suitable for use over existing tiles and waterproofing membranes
    - SikaTile®-010 Secure Prime is not suitable for use on plastics, metal, or glass.
    - Do not use in high windy conditions to avoid flash setting.
    - All curing compounds, mould release agents must be removed before application of SikaTile®-010 Secure Prime
    - SikaTile®-010 Secure Prime is suitable for use over early aged concrete and screeds, as a primer for tiling applications only. If waterproofing early aged concrete or screeds use an appropriate Sika moisture barrier as a primer.
    - If the primed area is left exposed for longer than 24- hours, the area should be wiped down with cleaned with water.
    - For use other than mentioned in this document please contact Sika® Australia.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.6):
    - Use in temperatures between 5°C and 35°C
    - SikaTile®-010 Secure Prime is suitable for use over early aged concrete and screeds, as a primer for tiling applications only. If waterproofing early aged concrete or screeds use an appropriate Sika moisture barrier as a primer.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaTile®-010 Secure Prime, November 2024, Version 01.06, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/h/sikatile-010-secureprime.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SikaTile®-010 Secure Prime, version 07/09/2022, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/SikaTile%C2%AE-010%20Secure%20Prime
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaTile®-010 Secure Prime, version 29/03/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/t/sds-sikatile-010secureprime.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
